{"code":"import random

def generate(rng):
    h=rng.randint(3,8)
    w=rng.randint(3,8)
    # Sparse, varied ARC-style grids with a background and a few colored objects.
    g=[[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1,5)):
        color=rng.randint(1,9)
        y=rng.randrange(h); x=rng.randrange(w)
        shape=rng.choice(['single','hline','vline','block'])
        if shape=='single': cells=[(y,x)]
        elif shape=='hline': cells=[(y,x+i) for i in range(rng.randint(1,3)) if x+i<w]
        elif shape=='vline': cells=[(y+i,x) for i in range(rng.randint(1,3)) if y+i<h]
        else: cells=[(yy,xx) for yy in range(y,min(h,y+2)) for xx in range(x,min(w,x+2))]
        for yy,xx in cells: g[yy][xx]=color
    return g"}
